newsitem.title: USA: Moovies to buy 21 video specialty stores.
newsitem.headline: Moovies to buy 21 video specialty stores.

text.p: Moovies Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire 21 video specialty stores and 43 franchised stores from Michigan-based Movie Warehouse Inc and affiliates.

The transaction, contingent upon certain terms and conditions including the completion of its recently announced $60 million senior credit facility, will consist of cash, stock and a note taken by the owner.
It said the 21 stores to be acquired are located in the greater Detroit area. It said the franchise operations it will acquire are located in Kentucky, Florida, Texas and Louisiana.
